title: Linked-Intent Development
tagline: How do you know your agent built what you meant?
framing: Because you wrote it down — a design, in plain English.
Because everything the agent builds comes from that design.
Because you can check: one ID grep returns the requirement, its tests, and its code.
Because LID helped you get there.
description: Linked-Intent Development for agentic coding — write the design in plain English; your agent derives one-line requirements with greppable IDs, then tests and code that cite them. Claude Code plugins; rule-file adapters for Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, and other tools.

quickstart.note: Register the plugin source in Claude Code.
Install arrow-maintenance, which tracks the links between specs and code in projects too big for one context window.
Describe what you want to build. The workflow scaffolds the docs/ tree and CLAUDE.md as it walks you through the design.

experimental.name: lid-experimental
experimental.blurb: Opt-in experimental skills that aren't part of the core workflow. Currently bundles bidirectional-differential — audits EARS↔code coherence by reconstructing each side from the other in fresh Claude sessions.
